identityAndRules.runtimeItemIdentity: ItemDefinition ScriptableObject reference equality (asset object identity). Matching Id strings do not make two different asset instances stackable.
identityAndRules.saveIdentity: ItemDefinition.Id is intended as a stable unique key for save-game/external data. The package does not generate IDs or implement persistence.
identityAndRules.stackRule: One ItemSlot stores at most one item definition and up to ItemDefinition.MaxStackSize units.
identityAndRules.amountRule: ItemStack constructor clamps negative amounts to zero. Empty means Data is null or Amount <= 0. ItemSlot.SetItem clamps to the definition's MaxStackSize.
identityAndRules.maxStackRule: MaxStackSize is normalized to at least 1 in ItemDefinition.OnValidate and ItemStack.MaxStackSize.
identityAndRules.mutationThread: Inventory and UnityEvent operations are intended for Unity's main thread.
nonGoals: No automatic world drop or prefab spawning

fields.name: Id
fields.purpose: Stable unique save key; caller assigns and preserves it.

fields.name: Prefab
fields.purpose: Optional world prefab for game-specific use.

fields.name: SellPrice
fields.purpose: Price per unit; no currency system included.

methods.name: OnValidate
methods.purpose: Clamps MaxStackSize to at least 1 and SellPrice to at least 0.

fields.name: Data
fields.purpose: Definition asset reference; null means empty.

constructors.purpose: Creates a stack and clamps amount at zero.

methods.name: CanStackWith
methods.purpose: True only when both stacks are non-empty and Data references are identical.

methods.name: WithAmount
methods.purpose: Returns a new stack with the same definition and a normalized amount.

methods.name: ToString
methods.purpose: Returns Empty or item name with quantity.

members.name: OnItemChanged
members.purpose: Raised when definition or amount changes.

methods.name: SetItem
methods.purpose: Replaces contents; null/zero clears; quantity is clamped to one slot capacity; emits OnItemChanged only when content differs.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.purpose: Adds as much as possible; returns remainder. Empty input returns zero; incompatible/full slot returns full input amount.

methods.name: SwapWith
methods.purpose: Exchanges slot contents and notifies both changed slots. Null/self ignored.

types.name: InventoryController

serializedFields.name: slots
serializedFields.purpose: Ordered fixed slot list configured in Inspector.

events.name: OnItemUsed
events.purpose: Game-specific item use event; core inventory does not invoke it automatically.

events.name: OnItemAdded
events.purpose: Invoked after add with accepted quantity.

events.name: OnItemRemoved
events.purpose: Invoked after removal with actual quantity. Clear emits once per previous slot stack.

methods.name: IsValidIndex
methods.returns: false for out-of-range index.

methods.name: GetSlot
methods.returns: Slot or null when invalid.

methods.name: FindSlot
methods.returns: First matching non-empty slot; -1 if missing/null.

methods.name: FindEmptySlot
methods.returns: First empty slot; -1 if full.

methods.name: CountItem
methods.returns: Total quantity; zero for null definition.

methods.name: ContainsItem
methods.returns: True when valid data and amount >= 0 and count >= amount.

methods.name: CanFit
methods.returns: Whether full stack fits into matching partial stacks plus empty slots; no mutation.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.returns: Quantity not accepted. Fills matching partial stacks, then empty slots.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.returns: Delegates to ItemStack overload; returns remainder.

methods.name: RemoveItem
methods.returns: All-or-nothing removal across matching slots from last to first.

methods.name: RemoveFromSlot
methods.returns: Removes up to amount from one slot; requested amount clamps to slot quantity.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.returns: Removes all stacks of definition; returns removed count.

methods.name: ClearSlot
methods.returns: Clears one valid non-empty slot and emits OnItemRemoved.

methods.name: Clear
methods.returns: Clears all slots; emits OnItemRemoved per previous stack.

methods.name: TryMove
methods.returns: Moves to empty, merges if same definition or swaps if incompatible; remainder stays at source.

methods.name: MoveToFirstAvailable
methods.returns: Tries first compatible partial stack, otherwise first empty slot; compatible merge may be partial.

methods.name: SplitStack
methods.returns: Splits into first empty slot.

methods.name: SplitStack
methods.signature: bool SplitStack(int fromIndex, int toIndex, int amount)
methods.returns: Splits to specified empty slot. Requires 0 < amount < source amount.

methods.name: SwapSlots
methods.returns: Swaps contents of two valid distinct slots.

methods.name: TransferTo
methods.signature: bool TransferTo(InventoryController target, int fromIndex, int amount)
methods.returns: Transfers as many as target accepts; removes only accepted quantity from source; false when none transferred.

methods.name: AutoStack
methods.returns: Fills earlier compatible partial slots from later slots; emits slot-level events.

lifecycle: Awake and editor OnValidate create missing slot objects for null list entries.
No runtime slot-count resize method is included. Configure slot count in the serialized slots list.

sampleUiTypes.name: ItemView

sampleUiTypes.name: RuntimeInventoryUIBuilder

importantBehavior: AddItem returns a remainder, not a success bool. Zero means everything fit.
RemoveItem is transactional/all-or-nothing; RemoveFromSlot clamps to the available slot quantity.
TransferTo is partial; it adds to target first, then removes only accepted units from source.
Move and split mutate slots and trigger ItemSlot.OnItemChanged but do not raise inventory OnItemAdded/OnItemRemoved events.
AutoStack also triggers slot-level change events; it does not raise inventory add/remove events.
Clear and ClearSlot are removals and now raise OnItemRemoved.
CanFit and all query methods are non-mutating except that missing serialized slot instances are normalized.
UI sample's sell/drop/discard actions remove the stack and then raise their corresponding game-specific events. Currency/world spawning remain external responsibilities.
compatibilityNotes: Existing serialized field names slots, item, Data, Amount are retained.
ItemDefinition Id is not automatically generated; save systems must supply stable unique IDs.
